comments.author: Schaf-Unschaf
comments.body:
I'm always wondering.. where do the textures come from?
I can model but doing anything related to textures is way beyond me.

replies.author: zenmatrix83
replies.body:
you can do pbr textures in blender, substance 3d from adobe is a good paid one, I made my own pbr tool. its node based meaning the are procedural, but you can also do painting or a mixture with layers.

  
[https://www.adobe.com/learn/substance-3d-designer/web/the-pbr-guide-part-2](https://www.adobe.com/learn/substance-3d-designer/web/the-pbr-guide-part-2)
